name: Flatten Table
changes: In the free version, a view that sets Group by column or Filter column shows a line in the bar that names these Pro options and says that the view does not use them. Click the line to see how to get Pro.
tip: Hold Shift and click column headers to sort by several columns at once.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Flatten Table is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.
